notes: Seed-data mismatch vs briefing: the briefing states 6 demo clients with stock Unsplash/Pexels photos should exist, but the live DB only had 2 clients ('wanda danil' with 1 photo, 'Uji Drive Rekursif' with 22 photos) at test start. This is a data-state discrepancy, not an app bug — all criteria were still exercised using self-created tscheck- fixtures plus the pre-existing 'Uji Drive Rekursif' client (read-only use, never mutated).

The admin create/update payload field for the Drive folder link is `drive_folder` (not `drive_folder_url` as implied by the briefing's field naming) — discovered via a first failed backend-test attempt, corrected, and re-verified. Documenting for the next agent's benefit.
Left several tscheck-* fixture clients in the DB (own namespace only, per fixture-isolation rules); cleanup is optional and was not required for pass/fail.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX — client linked to a real public Drive folder shows ALL photos (22), not just one
checks.name: test_drive_recursive_listing_full_photo_set
checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/clients {drive_folder: .../1tto2XSxREQHgTa7CRyjMftifVK8jzeyi} -> 200, then GET /api/admin/clients shows photo_count=22; GET /api/clients/{id} returns 22 photos with thumb/full fields; POST /api/admin/clients/{id}/sync -> 200, count stays 22.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX — client linked to a real public Drive folder shows ALL photos (22), not just one
checks.name: admin-drive-full-photos
checks.evidence: Admin adds client 'tscheck-drivefull-<ts>' with the Drive folder link; admin row shows photo count 22; guest gallery page for that client shows 'gallery-photo-count' containing '22 Foto' and 22 gallery-photo-item tiles. Screenshots: admin-row-22-photos, gallery-22-tiles.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX — Drive photos actually render as images (not broken boxes)
checks.name: drive-photos-render-as-images
checks.evidence: Sampled 5 elements inside gallery-photo-item tiles on the Drive-backed gallery; each resolved to naturalWidth > 0 within 20s via the thumb/full/alt fallback chain. Screenshot: sample-images-loaded.

checks.criterion: Manual re-sync keeps the full photo set
checks.name: admin-resync-keeps-photo-count
checks.evidence: Clicked admin-client-sync-btn on a fresh Drive-backed client; a success toast appeared and the row's photo count remained 22 (did not drop to 1 or 0). Screenshot: sync-toast.

checks.criterion: Invalid Drive link is rejected clearly
checks.name: test_invalid_drive_link_rejected
checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/clients {drive_folder: 'https://example.com/nope'} -> 400 {"detail":"Link folder Google Drive tidak valid"}; subsequent GET /api/clients confirms no client with that name was created.

checks.criterion: Invalid Drive link is rejected clearly
checks.name: invalid-drive-link-rejected-ui
checks.evidence: Admin form with drive URL 'https://example.com/nope' shows a non-empty Indonesian error in admin-form-error ('Link folder Google Drive tidak valid'); after Batal, no admin-client-row for that client name exists. Screenshot: invalid-link-error.

checks.criterion: Guest home lists clients with no login
checks.name: test_public_clients_listing_has_required_fields / test_public_listing_grows_with_new_client_no_auth_needed_to_view
checks.evidence: Unauthenticated GET /api/clients returns id/name/photo_count for all rows and GET /api/clients/{id} works without cookies; a freshly admin-created client is immediately visible via the same unauthenticated GET.

checks.criterion: Guest home lists clients with no login
checks.name: guest-home-lists-clients-no-login
checks.evidence: Home page (no auth) rendered clients-grid with >=6 client-card-item cards (topped up via API fixtures since live DB only had 2 clients), each with title/date; clicking a card's open button navigated to a gallery-title. Screenshots: home-cards, gallery-opened.

checks.name: gallery-lightbox-navigation
checks.evidence: On 'Uji Drive Rekursif' gallery (22 photos, read-only), clicked photo -> lightbox-modal shows '1 dari 22'; next-btn -> '2 dari 22'; ArrowRight -> '3 dari 22'; ArrowLeft -> '2 dari 22'; Escape closed the modal. Screenshots: lightbox-first, lightbox-after-nav.

checks.name: test_admin_crud_create_edit_delete
checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/clients -> 200 creates tscheck-crud-<id>; visible via GET /api/clients; PUT renames it, GET /api/clients/{id} reflects new name; DELETE removes it, subsequent GET /api/clients/{id} -> 404.

checks.name: admin-crud-add-edit-delete
checks.evidence: Added client via admin form (visible in admin table and guest home), edited its name (both surfaces updated), deleted it (row removed from admin table and gone from guest home search). Screenshots: created, edited, deleted.

checks.name: test_wrong_pin_rejected / test_correct_pin_accepted / test_admin_endpoint_requires_session
checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/login {pin:9999} -> 401 {"detail":"PIN salah"}; POST with pin 1234 -> 200 {"ok":true}; GET /api/admin/clients without session cookie -> 401.

checks.name: admin-wrong-pin-rejected
checks.evidence: Entering PIN 9999 shows non-empty Indonesian error in admin-pin-error; client manager (admin-add-client-btn, admin-client-row) never rendered. Screenshot: wrong-pin-error.
